input: Observed array SNPs only; singleton phase-only processing; impute=false; no added variants, missing-GT filling, DS substitution or changed diploid calls
reference_policy: User-approved 3033 existing dense-reference people, subset of the original labelled identity-disjoint reference
training_policy: User-approved 240 existing dense pure-training people plus original pedigree-training families whose entire founder set is available; selection uses identities, never performance
panel_policy: All exact typed CHROM/POS/REF/ALT keys available in dense data within original physical spans and map bounds; no artificial 197260-site cap; common reference-only quality filters for all methods
flare: Native seven-source posteriors, no GMM decoder or old dense-trained copying parameters; EM is singleton, update-p=false
gnomix: Fresh reference-only LR base and training-only CRF per exact panel; no kernel SVM, missing padding or evaluation labels in fitting
evaluation: Same previously inspected 14 controls, seven pure and seven balanced pedigrees, under both masks; pilot, not independent certification
truth: Original realized physical-base-pair fractions over full half-open chromosome spans; not marker-count truth
aggregation: Physical midpoint posterior cells, both copies equally weighted; identical across methods
reporting: Separate mask, phase, pure/pedigree and native/calibrated tracks; TV, tails, 5/10-point coverage, off-target/source errors and runtime; reject partial-autosome scores
supersedes: Imputed-array acceptance requirements; restricted common-panel pilot remains a compatibility diagnostic
